#!/bin/bash
# Test runner: runs every tests/test_*.sh, writes build/test-report.txt.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
mkdir -p build
pass=0; fail=0; total=0
for t in tests/test_*.sh; do
  name=$(basename "$t" .sh)
  total=$((total + 1))
  if bash "$t" > "build/$name.log" 2>&1; then
    pass=$((pass + 1)); echo "ok   $name"
  else
    fail=$((fail + 1)); echo "FAIL $name"; sed 's/^/    /' "build/$name.log"
  fi
done
if [ "$fail" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "PASS $pass/$total" | tee build/test-report.txt
else
  echo "FAIL $fail/$total" | tee build/test-report.txt
  exit 1
fi
# Each config: env matches the file name, port is a number, replicas >= 1,
# and every feature flag is a boolean.
status=0
for f in config/*.json; do
  env=$(basename "$f" .json)
  jq -e --arg env "$env" '
    (.env == $env) and (.port | type == "number") and (.replicas >= 1)
    and ([.features[] | type == "boolean"] | all)' "$f" > /dev/null \
    || { echo "invalid: $f"; status=1; }
done
exit $status
